quote:
1. I commend you because you remember me in everything             THE TRADITION

     and maintain the traditions as I have delivered them to you.

     ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

2. Now (de) I want you to understand that              A THEOLOGICAL

     the head (origin) of every man is Christ,          PRINCIPLE

     the head (origin) of women is man,

     the head (origin) of Christ is God.

     -----------------------------------------

3. Any man who prays or prophesies                     CHURCH PRACTICE

     with his head covered                             (and its reason)

     dishonors his head,

     any woman who prays or prophesies

     with her head unveiled

     dishonors her head -

4.   for it is the same as if her head were shaved, EXAMPLE - WOMEN

     for if a woman (prophet) will not veil herself, (shaved = dishonor/disgrace)

     then let her cut off her hair;

     But if it is disgraceful for a woman to be shorn or shaved

     then let her wear a veil.

     is it proper for a woman to pray to God unveiled?

12. Does not nature itself teach you                   EXAMPLE - MEN
         that for a man to wear long hair              (long hair = dishonor)

         but if a woman has long hair,                 (long hair = glory)
         it is her glory?
         For her hair is given to her for a covering.

13. If anyone is disposed to be contentious            CHURCH PRACTICE
    we recognize no other practice,
    nor do the churches of God.
